content: Better Auth twoFactor plugin: server twoFactor({issuer}) + client twoFactorClient(); sign-in returns twoFactorRedirect true then authClient.twoFactor.verifyTotp({code, trustDevice}); enable requires password and returns totpURI+backupCodes, active after first code verify unless skipVerificationOnEnable; auth.api.enableTwoFactor needs session headers; adds user.twoFactorEnabled and twoFactor table; trusted device 30 days.
